blocks.text: Era Zero now has 180 canonical roots and 144 provisional roots in 16 nine-root chunks. No completed review packet awaits a decision. The broad English translator remains blocked. A restricted explicit-ID renderer may cover only the 180 canonical roots and must reject provisional meanings, unapproved compounds, and underspecified grammar.

The next semantic block is WRN:200–222. It was not begun in this packet. The standing authorization permits it to proceed next under the same nine-root validation boundary. After WRN:200–222, a full-family Warning audit is required. Gate 4, the compound architecture, and translator implementation remain deferred.
